conventions.curve: X1(m,n), m | n, parametrises (E,P,Q) with <P,Q> = Z/m x Z/n; defined over Q(zeta_m)
conventions.degree: absolute degree [Q(x):Q] of the closed point x; relative degree = degree / phi(m)
conventions.sporadic: a closed point of degree d is sporadic if the curve has only finitely many closed points of degree d
conventions.gonality: Q-gonality for m <= 2 (torsion_inf tables); for m >= 3 only Abramovich's geometric lower bound
